title: AERO user token payload (C3, draft)
description: Payload of an aero1 token. The signature covers the exact payload bytes (see api/token.md); verifiers must verify before parsing.

iss.description: Issuer: sub (commercial platform) or edge (node-local console).

kid.description: Signing key id; selects the public key on the verifier.

uid.description: Opaque user id. MUST NOT contain email, phone or name (PII).

jti.description: Unique token id, used by the revocation list (C4).

tier.description: Plan tier. admin = unlimited quota, still authenticated.

classes.description: Traffic classes this token may open (ADR-0003).

max_devices.description: Concurrent QUIC connections allowed per uid on one edge.

quota_bytes.description: Traffic quota for the billing period; 0 or absent = unlimited.

exp.description: Expires at, Unix seconds. exp - iat <= 604800 (7 days).
